postfinance_mutations_result_check.name: postfinance_mutations_result_check
postfinance_mutations_result_check.value: ("postfinance_mutations"."state"='completed' AND "postfinance_mutations"."response_json" IS NOT NULL AND "postfinance_mutations"."claim_token" IS NULL) OR ("postfinance_mutations"."state" IN ('claimed','uncertain') AND "postfinance_mutations"."response_json" IS NULL AND "postfinance_mutations"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL)

postfinance_webhook_lease_check.name: postfinance_webhook_lease_check
postfinance_webhook_lease_check.value: ("postfinance_webhook_inbox"."state"='processing' AND "postfinance_webhook_inbox"."lease" IS NOT NULL AND "postfinance_webhook_inbox"."lease_until">0) OR ("postfinance_webhook_inbox"."state"<>'processing' AND "postfinance_webhook_inbox"."lease" IS NULL AND "postfinance_webhook_inbox"."lease_until"=0)
